The '''Eleventh Army''', also known as '''Blazing Claw Command''', was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and later [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector Army/Legends|Sector Army]] charged with the defense of the [[Gordian Reach Oversector]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the 11th [[Sector/Legends|Sector]] [[Army/Legends|Army]] was assigned as a military salient to prevent [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] enclaves on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian]] and [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian]] from joining forces.<ref name="TEGTW" />
